public_api_rule: Canonical public methods must not expose owner_confirmed, owner_approved or owner_approval_reference caller shortcuts.
admission_rule: Every owner-reserved action requires a fresh provider-backed owner decision receipt bound to the exact gate, evidence identity and evidence content SHA-256.
payment_rule: Revenue recognition additionally requires fresh live payment-provider authority, settled provider-native evidence, exact contract, amount and currency matching, and a provider-backed owner decision receipt.
external_case_study_rule: Caller labels and reference-provider evidence cannot establish an external customer outcome. Publication requires admitted external customer evidence, live customer-market authority and live owner-decision authority.
mock_provider_rule: Mock-provider conformance may prove contracts, persistence and rejection behaviour, but it cannot establish revenue, customer demand, a contract, partner adoption, an external case study or any other external maturity gate.
